The '''Royal Casino''', formerly '''Lucky's Tavern''', was a casino located in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. It was built by [[Lucky Malnock]] who named the establishment after himself. After his retirement as a wealthy man, Lucky sold the tavern which then became a place of [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] under the new management.

When [[Jacc Mandelbrot]] bought the district that surrounded the tavern, he renamed it Royal Casino. [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] had a stake in the business.

==Locations==
===The Ante Room===
This was the location of the original [[Lucky's Tavern]]. The room contained a dance floor that used [[Gravity generator/Legends|gravity generators]] to vary the gravity level from one g to roughly twice the gravity of Cloud City in the center of the floor.<ref name="GG2" />

Gambling machines lined the walls enabling patrons to play games such as [[warp-top]], [[Spatz]] and [[Jubilee Wheel (game)|Jubilee Wheel]].<ref name="GG2" />

===The Card Hall===
The Card Hall was up a set of stairs from the Ante Room and had a [[Sound-dampening field|dampener field]] to block out the noise from the dance floor. While it was technically open to the public, the tables were controlled by wealthy individuals or groups and people needed an invite to play cards. A table was reserved for use of members of the [[Corellian Merchants' Guild/Legends|Corellian Merchants' Guild]].<ref name="GG2" />

The bar was circular-shaped and set off to the side of the tables. It was staffed entirely by biological servers. Droids, datapads, weapons and non house cards were all banned from The Card Hall, a room where games such as [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] and [[Liar's Cut/Legends|liar's cut]] were played.<ref name="GG2" />
